name: CLIENTI
ddl:
CREATE TABLE "CLIENTI" 
   (	"ID" NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9999999999999999999999999999 INCREMENT BY 1 START WITH 1 CACHE 20 NOORDER  NOCYCLE	NOKEEP	NOSCALE  NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"NUME" VARCHAR2(15) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"PRENUME" VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"CNP" VARCHAR2(13) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"ADRESA" VARCHAR2(255), 
	"TELEFON" VARCHAR2(9) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"DISPONIBIL" NUMBER(12,2) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "CK_CLIENTI_CNP" CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(CNP, '^[0-9]{13}$')) ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "CK_CLIENTI_TELEFON" CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(TELEFON, '^[0-9]{9}$')) ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "CK_CLIENTI_DISPONIBIL" CHECK (DISPONIBIL >= 0) ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "PK_CLIENTI" PRIMARY KEY ("ID")
  USING INDEX  ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "UQ_CLIENTI_CNP" UNIQUE ("CNP")
  USING INDEX  ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "UQ_CLIENTI_TELEFON" UNIQUE ("TELEFON")
  USING INDEX  ENABLE
	 ) ;

name: ACHIZITII
ddl:
CREATE TABLE "ACHIZITII" 
   (	"ID" NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9999999999999999999999999999 INCREMENT BY 1 START WITH 1 CACHE 20 NOORDER  NOCYCLE  NOKEEP  NOSCALE  NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"CLIENT_ID" NUMBER NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"PRODUS" VARCHAR2(255) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"DATA_ACHIZITIE" DATE NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"PRET" NUMBER(12,2) NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	"SUMA_INCASATA" NUMBER(12,2) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "CK_ACHIZITII_PRET" CHECK (PRET > 0) ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "CK_ACHIZITII_INCASATA" CHECK (SUMA_INCASATA >= 0) ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "PK_ACHIZITII" PRIMARY KEY ("ID")
  USING INDEX  ENABLE, 
	 CONSTRAINT "FK_ACHIZITII_CLIENTI" FOREIGN KEY ("CLIENT_ID")
		REFERENCES "CLIENTI" ("ID") ENABLE
   ) ;
